judge.voice: Ahoj. The topic was right for me, and the one correction was exactly what I needed. I did say 'used to communicate', and the tip showed 'communicating'. Later Leo asked 'Do you enjoy speaking up in class debates?', which is not B2 First level, and he praised me with 'smart plan'. The summary says three answers had help, but I used it once. I would use it again for the corrections, but I'd still check the rules myself. I would not yet tell my class.
